7.author: itswicky(246421954062581760)
7.description:
Regenerative Shadows has been reworked to: Dealing damage with Mind Flay grants you a Soul Fragment. Soul Fragments grant you 1% increased casting speed for 12 seconds, stacking up to 9 times. Upon reaching 9 stacks you gain Shadow Visions for the next 12 seconds. Shadow Visions empowers your next ability:

Shadow Word: Pain- Afflicts up to 3 additional nearby enemies.

Mind Blast- causes the target to take 5% more Shadow damage from the caster for 5 seconds.

Devouring Plague- Increases its duration by 50%.

7.description: Total Eclipse has been reworked to: dealing damage with Wrath while Solar Eclipse is active reduces the cooldown of your Treants by 2 seconds and dealing damage with Starfire with Lunar Eclipse is active reduces the cooldown of your Starfall by 2 seconds.
